*****Imagine, you are all down at our private beach and your 12-year-old son is hungry or your 15-year-old daughter wants to run up to the house to use the bathroom instead of those by our 2 beach side pools. Well, at ours they can safely run up to the house in 2 minutes, never cross busy 30A, grab a snack and be back down with the family in minutes! Our extensive 9-month whole house renovation is complete, and our home is immaculate! From August we go to a 4-night minimum until mid-October and 3-night minimum from then on through the winter months to encourage long weekend stays. Our rates are lower than others because we have no mortgage to service which means more affordable rates for you! You can see more videos on Insta-g @browneyedgirl_seagrove *****

Welcome to the NEW Brown Eyed Girl with 130+ 5-Star Reviews — a luxurious sanctuary in the coveted Summer's Edge community that offers the perfect blend of modern elegance and coastal charm. Following an extensive $350,000 renovation, this beachside retreat is poised to redefine your vacation experience. The photos are brand new. The virtual tour is from before the renovation, but it shows the floorplan well.

Located on the Gulf-side of 30A, this exclusive property ensures convenience, safety, and unmatched proximity to the pristine sands and emerald waters and on the gulf side of 30A.

Be among the first to experience this reimagined masterpiece. With high demand and limited availability, now is the time to secure your stay in this extraordinary home. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to provide unparalleled comfort and style. Whether you’re planning a family getaway, a romantic escape, or a special celebration, Brown Eyed Girl is the ideal setting to create lasting memories.

Availability is already filling up for the 2026 season. Don’t miss your chance to claim this newly transformed gem in Summer’s Edge. Book today and ensure your place in a truly unforgettable coastal experience.

Brown Eyed Girl boasts an open and inviting living space featuring southern wide shutters, board-and-batten walls throughout, a wet bar with a beverage refrigerator, custom furnishings, and a state-of-the-art 65” TCL Roku 4K Smart TV. The chef’s kitchen is a culinary dream, complete with Bosch appliances, a double oven, a gas range, and a central island with a built-in sink and microwave drawer. The adjacent dining area includes a spacious dining table and a large island with additional seating—perfect for entertaining or casual family meals. We have also added a 120-pound daily ice machine so you can top off your beach cooler and we provide a large Gorilla beach wagon to boot!

The home’s three bedrooms are designed with relaxation in mind. The secluded master suite spans the entire second floor, featuring a king-size pillow-top Sealy mattress, a spa-inspired bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub, and a private rooftop deck with seating for five—the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening cocktails under the stars. The other two bedrooms on the main floor include plush queen Sealy beds, one with a set of bunk beds and a trundle to accommodate up to five guests. All rooms feature wall-mounted Smart TVs and USB charging outlets for convenience. The bunk bedroom has a secret nook hideout your children will love to explore too.

Outdoors, enjoy the front porch with ceiling fan, a private fenced dog run, and an outdoor shower with privacy fencing, plus a paver side patio for grilling. Relax by the lushly landscaped surroundings or take a three-minute stroll to our community's private beach using your private gated access and reservable canvas chairs and umbrellas. Two exclusive and private neighborhood pools—one heated in season—offer additional options for swimming and relaxation.

Located just a short walk from Greenway Station, you’ll find everything from gourmet coffee and wine bars to boutique shops and casual dining. Explore the scenic 18-mile bike path along 30A or visit nearby attractions like Seaside, Grayton Beach, and Rosemary Beach. For those seeking adventure, paddle boards are available at YOLO across the street, and they will deliver. We have a 10% discount set up at YOLO, just mention our house name. Endless trails, beautiful clear seas and exploring local state parks provide endless possibilities and there is a trail head across the street!

We suggest you call 30A Shade and rent reserved oceanfront canvas beach chairs and umbrella service and we have a discount set up with them, call in advance so you get an ocean front spot! Our relaxed cancellation policy and commitment to rebooking canceled dates ensure your peace of mind. Plus, we conditionally may welcome one well-behaved dog under 25 pounds with prior approval and veterinary weight documentation and nails trimmed.

Brown Eyed Girl is more than just a vacation home—it’s a place where cherished memories are made. Book now to secure your dates in this coveted property before it’s too late. Don’t wait—paradise is calling.

Greenway Station merchants next door include Canopy Road Cafe for breakfast, Turbo Coffee, Yolo Paddle Boards, Salty Butcher, Wild Olive Wine Bar & Store, Cantina Tex-Mex restaurant, The Lodge Hotel, Southern Tide Apparel, Ice Cream & Candy store and more. Yolo Bikes delivers and Yellowfin Tackle is close by. Buddy's and Goatfeathers seafood shops are close by. Perfect Pig, Steamboat Grill and Old Florida Fish House are walking distance too!

For a closer look, check out our YouTube videos:
- Beach Proximity Video: https://youtu.be/HYO-0JASoEE
- Dog Friendly Dog Run Video: https://youtu.be/f7ANmsHcXTc
- Neighborhood Tour 5 Years Ago: https://youtu.be/oIW5tncpgTg
- Relaxing Beach Vibes: https://youtu.be/6UxmW8E4KYU

Due to such limited parking, our community does not allow golf carts. You can rent a three-wheel tricycle for elderly guests and have it delivered and Yolo & Big Fish will deliver regular bikes right to the house at 10% discounted rates. We have several great restaurants within 10 minutes-walk and then you can indulge freely!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: The Brown Eyed Girl was the most welcoming rental we have ever stayed in. It’s a home full of character, with thoughtful design and everything you could possibly need for a comfortable stay. I have never rented from someone as kind and helpful as Josh. He truly made the experience exceptional.The heated community pool was a huge plus, and the short walk to the beach was amazing. I especially loved heading toward Eastern Lake and stepping into warm water, even when the ocean was cold—such a unique and relaxing experience.I can honestly say that if you stay here once, you’ll want to come back again and again. We also had so much fun reading through the guest book, dating back to 2015—it added such a special touch.The gourmet kitchen is incredible! Now I feel like I need to take cooking lessons just so I can come back and fully enjoy everything it has to offer.

reviews.text: We absolutely loved “Brown-Eyed Girl” from the moment we arrived in the neighborhood. The home is situated on a gorgeous, safe street that has such a homey feel to it. The owners have decorated the house so beautifully. The kitchen was stocked with everything we needed. I especially loved the nice Dutch oven, which we used often. While there are so many restaurants surrounding this area on 30A, you almost feel guilty leaving because of how inviting and spacious the kitchen feels. Unfortunately our trip did come to an end, and we left a few items behind. The owner and cleaning crew were so kind to work together to make sure we received those items. We have stayed at many rental properties along 30A, but this one checked all the boxes and is our favorite one to date! We look forward to returning soon.
